limitations.note: The agent registered the output but compared the post-shift value, so the match pulse still arrives one clock edge earlier than required by the pre-edge comparison.
The test compared `match` against the already-updated history, so even exhaustive transition coverage validated the agent's timing assumption rather than catching the one-cycle error.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The first simulation launch was blocked by its cleanup command, and the retry used an unavailable `python` executable, so the test setup had to be submitted a third time before simulation ran.
